title: Indonesia Nickel ESG Monitoring
thesis: Snowflake turns daily site data from a fictional nickel operator into discharge-quality, emissions-intensity, rehabilitation and grievance KPIs, 7-day exceedance-risk scores, turbidity anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Discharge samples within threshold, environmental exceedances, emissions intensity and community grievances for 30 sites across 4 provinces.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to site-day rows. Thresholds are internal demo thresholds, not regulatory limits.
The root-cause chart shows which exceedance causes put the most water samples over the threshold.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of ESG KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sites are likely to have the next exceedance?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each site's probability of an environmental exceedance in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags discharge turbidity outliers per site, and the forecast projects operator-wide CO2e emissions for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy are the controls behind those risks?

talking_points: Water treatment uptime and land rehabilitated frame the operator's environmental capacity.
Inspection completion against discharge within threshold by site shows where control discipline and water quality move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, exceedance, cause and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a discharge sensor alarms right now?

talking_points: Live turbidity and settling-pond readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the site's current risk band, then emails the environmental officer.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic exceedance-response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
